# tool/export_csv.py (current behavior)
def export_csv(rows, path, *, delimiter=","):
    # Writes plain CSV with default delimiter only
    import csv
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f, delimiter=delimiter)
        for r in rows:
            writer.writerow(r)
